verdict.rationale: Qodo's Agentic Toolbox brings its own review capabilities and coding standards into the developer's coding agent locally. Its CLI explicitly supports reviewing changes before opening a pull request, and plugins exist for Claude Code, Codex and the Kiro agent. However, there is no evidence of a dedicated IDE extension (e.g., VS Code or JetBrains) showing the review inline in the editor, and no evidence that the local review matches the PR review. Missing for 10: a documented native IDE plugin with in-editor review, explicit parity with the PR review findings, and hands-on corroboration of the pre-push workflow.
